tests.case: expansion marks yield to Play and reduced motion snaps all cover transitions

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Reduced_moti.reason: Every descendant and the tile itself have zero transition duration under the saved reduced-motion preference, including artwork, fallback title, scrim, expansion marks and both controls.

tests.case: fixed action targets and inside ring retain their geometry

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Hover_reveal.reason: At 108, 148 and 200 pixels, real pointer entry reveals unchanged 32-pixel primary and 40-pixel Details targets, with original tooltips and geometry relative to the cover.

tests.case: store words and compact stats never overlap

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Hover_stats_.reason: The full original five width/store/playtime combinations preserve complete store words, compact playtime and idle, contained scrim height and a shared chip/action bottom edge.

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Keyboard_foc.reason: Actual Tab reaches the cover, primary and Details buttons and reveals their dock; leaving the tile releases it.

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Pointer_clic.reason: A real primary click followed by pointer exit hides the dock despite retained pointer focus; selection remains an independent ring signal.

tests.case: the first pointer move exposes a live action target on all twelve immediate presses

CardDetailsInteractionTests.First_press_.reason: All twelve original move/down/up sequences dispatch exactly once to the primary action and never to Details.

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Keyboard_foc.reason: Tab focuses Details; replacing its work identity removes that focus and keeps incoming controls hidden until a fresh pointer move.

CardDetailsInteractionTests.Repeated_pri.reason: Two native pointer clicks and Space produce three primary invocations without opening Details. Pending requests refuse duplicates, expose sanitized failure guidance and allow retry.
